test_title: PYST 03: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Robin and Varun together can paint a hall in 6 days. Robin alone can paint it in 42 days. In how many days can Varun alone paint it?
solution:
**Given:**

Robin and Varun together can paint in 6 days

Robin alone can paint in 42 days

**Formula used:**

Work = LCM of days taken

Efficiency = Work ÷ Time

Time taken by Varun = Total work ÷ Varun’s efficiency

**Calculations:**

⇒ LCM of 6 and 42 = 42

⇒ Total work = 42 units

⇒ Robin’s 1 day work = 42 ÷ 42 = 1 unit

⇒ Together 1 day work = 42 ÷ 6 = 7 units

⇒ Varun’s 1 day work = 7 - 1 = 6 units

⇒ Time = 42 ÷ 6 = 7 days

**∴ Varun alone can paint the hall in 7 days.**
